source: Bitvavo public REST API + current V3/V4 outputs
purpose: Current full-universe leaderboard cross-checked against current V3/V4 watchlist presence. This runtime does not infer historical detection from current absence.
coverage_deprecation: DEPRECATED: coverage/either_coverage_pct measure current watchlist presence only; use current_watchlist_presence.

historical_detection.reason: No historical event index is an input to market_control.py in this runtime. Current absence must not erase a prior detection or BUY.

metric_definitions.CURRENT_WATCHLIST_PRESENCE_RATE: markets present now in V3 or V4 divided by the announced leaderboard denominator
metric_definitions.HISTORICAL_DETECTION_RATE: UNKNOWN until a timestamped historical detection-event source is joined
metric_definitions.TIMELY_DETECTION_RATE: UNKNOWN until a predeclared reference event and timestamped detection history are joined
